fix_text: Keep the 2026-09-18 insertion as is. Replace the 2026-09-24 ARL sentence with: "Occupational-risk (ARL) contributions are not due for the vacation days: vacation is a reportable change event (novedad) during which no employer ARL contribution accrues (Decreto 1072 de 2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6 num. 1.3, compiling Decreto 1772 de 1994 art. 19 as amended by Decreto 1528 de 2015). A Función Pública concept addressed to a public entity (Concepto 091961 de 2022) takes the contrary view without addressing that article; it is not binding (CPACA art. 28)."
reason: Part 1 (2026-09-18, vacation IBC = last base reported before the vacation began) is correct: Decreto 780/2016 art. 3.2.5.1, applied by the PILA Anexo Técnico 2 to the vacation line. Part 2 (2026-09-24, ARL) is wrong in substance and citation: it is not 'market practice' and not 'unsettled'. Decreto 1072/2015 art. 2.2.4.2.1.6 (compiling Decreto 1772/1994 art. 19, as amended by Decreto 1528/2015) lists vacation as novelty num. 1.3 (there is no 'lit. c') and states that no employer ARL contribution accrues during it. The Función Pública Concepto 091961/2022 does say the contrary, but it answers a public entity, relies only on Decreto-Ley 1295 art. 21, does not address the regulatory rule, and is non-binding (CPACA art. 28). The deleted original sentence (ARL not due for vacation days) was right; keep it with the citation.
